# Hello, Traveler!

My name is Kyle, and I'm a statistics student at Cornell University. While I'm fascinated by quantitative methods and the possibilities they offer, my greatest passion lies in using art as a medium of expression. A few fun facts about me: I'm an ENTJ, I love strategy games, and I sing R&B! I have plenty of other hobbies, many of which you'll discover in the Projects section of this website. I'm especially drawn to pursuits with high skill ceilings and plenty of room for creative freedom—there's something exciting about knowing there's always more to learn.

One of the most important parts of my life is my faith. I believe in God, and I see Him at work in my life, both for my good and for the glory of His Kingdom. Though life has its ups and downs, I find comfort in knowing that our present sufferings cannot compare to the glory that awaits us. Through His Word and His grace, I find lasting joy and fulfillment. I'm so thankful for the opportunity to praise God each day, and I hope to share some of my prayers and meditations with you here.

The full reason behind Kyle's World is honestly still a mystery, even to me. But I trust that God makes everything beautiful in its time. For now, I've created this website as an **Internet life gallery**—a space to document and share my passions, experiences, and blessings. Here, you'll find pieces of my work, my love, and my life.

Thank you for being here. Enjoy your stay!
